responseText:
Clan Cragforge, you say? Strange? why spare them, yet feast upon others? The only thread I see is this-Cragforge never laid hand to Sanctus, nor crossed the portal's threshold. 

Curious? deeply curious. 

I'll see your findings delivered to Bonfire. Let the elders weigh what wisdom they still carry. 

May the winds carry you safely, my friend-through shadow and silence alike.
name: ANV_NPC_Nikua_RukkHillstaker_11_Response
